arguments.sql:
SELECT p."PRD_ID", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD"
FROM "GLPERD" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."PRD_ID" = p."PRD_ID"
WHERE h."POST_DT" < p."STRT_DT" OR h."POST_DT" > p."END_DT"
ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD"
FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID"
WHERE p."STAT_CD" = 'C' AND h."POST_DT" >= 20240101 AND h."JRNL_NO" > 0
ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO" LIMIT 50

SELECT j."JRNL_NO", SUM(j."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS cr
FROM "GLJRNL" j GROUP BY j."JRNL_NO"
HAVING ROUND(SUM(j."DR_AMT") - SUM(j."CR_AMT"), 2) <> 0
ORDER BY j."JRNL_NO"

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) AS paid
FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID" = i."INV_ID"
GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD"
HAVING ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) - i."INV_AMT", 2) <> 0 AND i."STAT_CD" = 'P'
ORDER BY i."INV_ID"

SELECT UPPER(TRIM(BOTH '0' FROM REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i."VEND_CD"), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'))) AS vkey,
UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i."INV_NO"), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) AS invkey,
COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG(i."INV_ID" ORDER BY i."INV_ID") AS ids
FROM "APINVH" i
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."REF_JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."POST_DT"
FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL
AND h."REF_JRNL_NO" NOT IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH")
ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"

SELECT j."JRNL_NO", j."LN_SEQ", j."ACCT_CD", c."ACTV_FLG"
FROM "GLJRNL" j LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD") = TRIM(j."ACCT_CD")
WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR c."ACTV_FLG" <> 'Y'
ORDER BY j."JRNL_NO", j."LN_SEQ" LIMIT 50
